findings.title: Unfenced concurrent opposite verdicts let late acknowledgement contradict last accepted answer
findings.reproduction: Observed probe; click Gern wieder while its HTTP acknowledgement is held; Eher nicht remains enabled and second click emits keep:false. Model accepts in request arrival order true then false; false reply arrives first. Release old true acknowledgement.
findings.expected: Either single pending answer prevents opposite submissions, or serialized/revision-fenced latest intention and acknowledgement remain coherent; stale reply must not replace latest feedback.
findings.actual: Requests [true,false], last accepted synthetic API state false, UI replaced negative thanks by Danke. Der Song kommt wieder wie jeder andere.
findings.impact: Honest preference acknowledgement is violated, and slow requests permit duplicate/opposite commands. This is an API-intercept client race proof, not evidence of a real provider/database write.
findings.repair: Track pending answer and identity/request revision; serialize or reject opposite pending clicks and discard superseded callbacks.
required_tests: slow first reply with opposite second request and reverse reply order
account and occurrence changes during pending verdict

findings.title: Successful verdict response discards failed playback advance result
findings.reproduction: Observed probe in Home with native controller; intercept retest response HTTP200 {skipped:false,skipError:Gerät ist nicht erreichbar.}; click Eher nicht. Same response is a valid Hub result for an unsuccessful Spotify advance.
findings.expected: Separate persisted preference acknowledgement from failed or unobserved playback advance, show actual failure and allow recovery; native route must follow actual controller contract (backend reviewer separately reproduces native no advance).
findings.actual: Only affirmative preference thanks appears, error omitted. Home neither consumes skipped/skipError nor sends nativePlayer/command handling for this action.
findings.impact: A device refusal is hidden while the listener expects rejection to move on. Preference save is valid; transport success cannot be inferred.
findings.repair: Preserve backend result shape in API typing and expose skip failure distinctly. Integrate negative verdict with correct native command route and stable occurrence fences as separately verified by backend reviewer; do not gratuitously rewrite transport state machine.
required_tests: real Hub fakeSpotify failed next after negative verdict
native observed probe negative verdict queue advance
old occurrence callbacks do not advance new song

findings.title: Prior answer hides the next probe of the same song in a continuously open Home
findings.reproduction: Answer Eher nicht on probe track0. Observe track1 next. Later synthetic authoritative state observes track0 in a distinct queue occurrence entry-retest-new, kind probe, same listener.
findings.expected: A fresh observed probe occurrence asks again.
findings.actual: Home retains answered track0 and renders old thanks; both answer buttons absent.
findings.impact: Low-frequency long-lived view loses explicit verdict buttons on repeat probe; reloading/navigation clears it. Synthetic occurrence lifecycle verified; actual months-long open physical browser NOT_RUN.
findings.repair: Scope answer to profile/session/entry identity and reset or derive display from current authoritative occurrence.
required_tests: same song distinct queue occurrence after intervening song
